title: Basil Propagation Technique Revealed
reason: The video demonstrates the process of propagating basil plants from a single pot.

tasks.task: Explain the steps for propagating basil plants.

subtasks.text: Show the acquisition of a basil plant from the supermarket.
Describe the potential of the tiny stems in the basil plant.
Outline the process of removing the basil plants from their initial pot.
Demonstrate carefully teasing apart the roots of the basil plants.
Describe the act of repotting each stem.
Highlight the transformation of one pot of basil into 12 individual healthy plants.
